FFmpeg redistribution notice
============================

The release bundles ffmpeg.exe for local video decoding.

Build: 2022-08-31-git-319e8a49b5 essentials_build from gyan.dev
Project: https://ffmpeg.org/
Source revision: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/319e8a49b5
Build provider: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

This build reports that it was configured with --enable-gpl and
--enable-version3. The GNU General Public License version 3 is included in
licenses/FFmpeg/COPYING.GPLv3 inside the distributed application.

TURZX Pro invokes FFmpeg as a separate process and does not incorporate
FFmpeg source code into the application executable.
